units.source_text: [\[34\]](#part1330.html#w34) 按当时风习，除天皇、皇太子外，男子结婚一般都去女家。

en.t: According to the customs of the time, except for the emperor and the crown prince, a man who married would generally go to the woman’s family home.

units.source_text: 婚后女子仍居娘家，男子前往住宿。

en.t: After marriage, the woman still lived with her own family, and the man went there to stay overnight.

units.source_text: 适当时期后，新夫妇另居他处，或将妻子迎至丈夫邸内。

en.t: After a suitable period, the newly married couple would live somewhere else, or the wife would be brought into the husband’s residence.
